content:
maya: Heads-up — we need a short-lived SIEM export for an ongoing customer incident (PAYG-882). Need last 72h of auth + token_exchange logs for tenant-42. Can we do an ephemeral export to S3 for infra triage?

jon: @maya can we avoid full raw export? If S3, make it presigned + TTL (3-4h) and strip PII. Also confirm if KMS unwrap is needed.

rachel: prefer scoped saved search + tokenized fields + JIT unwrap via kms-proxy. Raw exports should be last resort. If export required, must include justification, TTL, and DLP signoff.

maya: OK will open a ticket. quick question — what role do we grant to oncall to run the export? minimal privileges?

samir: Create it under SEC-EXPORT and include: incident id, tenant, time-range, datasets, justification, ttl_hours. Minimum ephemeral role: siem_viewer_exporter (timeboxed). KMS unwrap must be via kms-proxy gateway; do NOT hand out CMK access.

maya: sample ticket body I'll paste into the ticket: 
```
incident: PAYG-882
tenant: tenant-42
range: 2026-03-19T00:00Z -> 2026-03-22T23:59Z
datasets: auth, token_exchange, api_gateway
justification: customer-facing outage, root cause triage
ttl_hours: 4
```

infra-bot: SEC-EXPORT-1091 created by maya and assigned to samir. ETA 25m. :gear:

samir: Plan: 1) run saved search with redaction rules, 2) stream to kafka->export job->s3 using kms-proxy (envelope encrypt), 3) create presigned link with 4h expiry, 4) set bucket lifecycle to auto-delete objects after 4h, 5) emit audit event. @oncall confirm you have MFA and DLP approval before accessing.

oncall: Confirmed — MFA and DLP approved. Will access only via presigned link and not persist locally. :white_check_mark:

rachel: After triage we'll: revoke siem_viewer_exporter entitlement, rotate ephemeral CMK, and capture audit entry + short blameless note in incident doc.

maya: Thanks team. I'll update SEC-EXPORT-1091 with the ticket body and include the triage timeline. Will ping when triage complete (target ~3.5h).
